examples.text: Президе́нт вы́прямился, вы́дохнул, опра́вил костю́м, вы́шел из храни́лища свое́й небы́строй, но энерги́чной похо́дкой, спусти́лся в кабине́т.
examples.translation: The president straightened up, exhaled, fixed his suit, left the storage room with his slow but energetic gait, and went down into his office.

examples.text: Cosmic rays are energetic particles from outer space.

glosses: Characterised by force or vigour; full of energy; lively, vigorous, furious.

examples.text: Those kids are so energetic: they want to run around playing all day.

examples.text: Unfortunately, conventional nanoporous energetics can have poor long-term storage stability, and can be dangerously unstable, severely limiting their usefulness.

glosses: Applied to a form of the verb; — opposed to passive. See active voice.

examples.text: "Alumni could become more active in giving guidance and leadership to students. They act as sort of a 'maturity governor' on fraternities," notes Ratliff, citing surveys suggesting that fraternity actives presume mistakenly that alumni want hazing […]

examples.text: Components are split into two broad segments: actives and passives. Active components like the vacuum tube and the transistor contain the power to generate and alter electrical signals.
